heat_discretization: Original full quadratic C3D10 transient PDE, identical original input bytes
mechanical_discretization: C3D10T: identical displacement interpolation and four actual integration points; native linear corner-temperature interpolation used for initial and current mechanical integration-point temperature
material_temperature_semantics: Native e_c3d.f sets both t0l and t1l via linscal10 for type10T. Thus the compatible mechanical integration-point temperature is also used for the temperature-dependent constitutive calculation; all original nodal temperatures remain retained.
native_temperature_formula: T_IP=sum_{a=1..4} L_a*T_corner_a, equivalent to the actual linscal10.f expression; no altered or synthesized heat solution
coupling: One-way true transient heat to quasistatic finite-strain J2 mechanics; no plastic-heat feedback or inertia claim
reduction: No POD, modal truncation, spatial field sampling or scalar surrogate; all FE nodes, four IPs per native element and13SDVs retained
